frontend: The staircase, vehicle / steering symbols, labels and explanatory boxes are frontend geometry; no photographic assets are needed.
Pictorial PNGs come from clean embedded source artwork, without the overlaid figure labels, formulas, frames, arrows or plotted annotations.
All text, formulas, borders, arrows, chart axes, sensor symbols and schematic lines will be separate frontend elements. Formulas use Cambria Math with source-matched italics.
Cutouts use transparent backgrounds; photographs preserve the rectangular scene content. Original placement is recorded in source pixels, separately from PDF placement.
